remediation_strategy.selected_strategy: Option B — Safety-Gate Synchronization with Explicit Deprecation (Option A hybrid)
remediation_strategy.justification: FusionRanker.classify_candidate was actively called by models/fusion_x/rank_anomalies.py. Safely synchronizing the temporal eligibility gate eliminates the ungated heuristic while maintaining executable prototype functionality and marking it deprecated in favor of production FusionEngine.

legacy_prototype_transient_promotion.before: if temporal_sig > 5.0 and not is_known_star: return 'NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE' (no temporal eligibility check).
legacy_prototype_transient_promotion.after: if temporal_sig > 5.0 and not is_known_star: if chronos_temporal_eligibility == 'TRUE': return 'NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE' else: return 'ANOMALOUS_RESIDUAL_REQUIRES_REVIEW'.

synthetic_demo_pipeline.before: rank_anomalies.py passed unverified synthetic exponential samples into classify_candidate, risking fabricated transient tags.
synthetic_demo_pipeline.after: rank_anomalies.py explicitly passes chronos_temporal_eligibility='FALSE', ensuring all synthetic anomalies are categorized as ANOMALOUS_RESIDUAL_REQUIRES_REVIEW.

changed_files_inventory.description: Added deprecation notice and synchronized temporal eligibility gate in FusionRanker.classify_candidate.
Explicitly passed chronos_temporal_eligibility='FALSE' to prevent synthetic transient fabrication.
14 focused regression tests verifying fail-closed behavior across all input conditions.
